svg.title: The ICA problem for two uniform sources
svg.desc: Three scatter plots. Four hundred pairs of independent sources, each uniform between minus one and one, fill a square. Multiplied by a mixing matrix A, they fill a parallelogram. Multiplied by an unmixing matrix that is the inverse of A with its rows swapped and one sign flipped, they fill a square again: the sources are recovered, but in the other order and with one negated.
